点 is the hour, 分 is minutes, 半 is half: 三点半 is 3:30. A time word goes before the verb: who + when + action (or when + who + action), but never at the end of the sentence.

What time is it? — Half past three.

Verb measure words show how many times an action is done. The formula: V + (了/过) + number + 次/遍 (+ object). 次 simply means "time", while 遍 means "a time from start to finish": reading something through, listening to something through, repeating something.

又 A 又 B means "both A and B" at the same time. The formula: 又 + adjective/verb + 又 + adjective/verb. Both parts are usually of the same "sign" — both good or both bad: 又便宜又好吃.

一 A 就 B means "as soon as A, then B". The formula: S + 一 + V1，(S) + 就 + V2. It also describes a habit: 他一喝酒就脸红 means "as soon as he drinks, his face turns red".

其实 means "actually, in fact". It introduces the truth that contradicts appearances or someone else's opinion. It usually goes at the start of the second part of a sentence.

却 means "but, yet": an adverb of contrast. It goes only after the subject, before the predicate: S + 却 + V. It's often paired with 虽然: 虽然…，S + 却….

倒 has two uses: 1) "on the contrary": an unexpected turn; 2) a concession: Adj + 倒是 + Adj，就是/可是… means "it is …, but …". It goes before the predicate.

并 + 不/没 strengthens a negation and refutes someone else's expectation: "not at all, by no means". The formula: S + 并 + 不/没(有) + V.

反而 means "on the contrary, instead": the result is the opposite of what was expected. The typical pattern: 不但不/没 A，反而 B.

即使 + hypothetical condition，(S) 也 + result means "even if …, still …". The condition is usually hypothetical, not yet happened.

尽管 + real fact，(S) 还是/仍然/却 + … means "even though …, still …". Unlike 即使, the situation here is real and already exists.

针对 shows which problem or group an action is aimed at. Formulas: 针对 + problem，+ action; 针对 + target + 的 + noun. It can also be a verb: 不是针对你.
针对这个问题，公司制定了新规定。
Zhēnduì zhège wèntí, gōngsī zhìdìng le xīn guīdìng.

鉴于 is a formal preposition used to officially justify a decision. Formula: 鉴于 + circumstance，+ decision/conclusion. It usually comes at the start of a sentence.
鉴于天气原因，航班推迟起飞。
Jiànyú tiānqì yuányīn, hángbān tuīchí qǐfēi.

随即 is a formal "immediately, right afterward": action 1，随即 + action 2. It is similar to 立刻, but shows that the second action follows directly after the first. Typical of narration and news.
接到通知后，他随即出发了。
Jiēdào tōngzhī hòu, tā suíjí chūfā le.

从而 means "thereby, and so": action/cause，从而 + result. The second part usually has no new subject and describes a positive outcome. The style is formal, often found in articles.
公司改进了技术，从而提高了产品质量。

以至于 (以至) means "so much that; to the point that": cause/degree，以至于 + extreme result. It shows how far things went. Formula: A + 得/太…，以至于 + B.

岂 is a formal "how could, surely not": a rhetorical question whose answer is obvious. Formula: 岂 + 能/会/可/有 + … ? For example: 岂能 = 怎么能, 岂有此理 — "that's outrageous".

Zhème zhòngyào de shì, qǐ néng suíbiàn juédìng?

何尝 — "when did…, not at all"
Write the hardest characters of the lesson on paper, 3–5 times each.
何尝 means "when did…, not at all": a negation in the form of a question. 何尝不 = in fact yes; 何尝 + verb = in fact no. Formula: subject + 何尝(不) + predicate.
我何尝不想去，只是没有时间。
Wǒ hécháng bù xiǎng qù, zhǐshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
Do you think I don't want to go? I just have no time.

When did he ever say such a thing?

Do you think I don't want to spend time with my child? There's just too much work.
A 其实 B 我 C 不 D 明白你的苦心。

其实我何尝不明白你的苦心。
In fact, don't I understand how much you care about me?

何苦 means "why (suffer so much)": a rhetorical question about an action that is not worth the effort or suffering. Formula: (你)何苦 + verb + 呢？ Close to 何必, but with sympathy: "why make such sacrifices".

Wèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì shēngqì, hékǔ ne?

莫非 means "could it be that, surely not…?": a guess in question form, often with surprise. Formula: 莫非 + supposition + (吗/不成)？ It is softer than 难道: the speaker leans toward the guess being true.
他今天没来，莫非生病了？
Tā jīntiān méi lái, mòfēi shēngbìng le?

岂止 means "far more than; not just": it shows that reality is broader than what was named. Formula: 岂止 + A，(还/更)…; or A岂止 + number/quality. It has a rhetorical tone: "A? Much more than that!".

层递 builds an idea in steps from smaller to larger: 不但A，而且B，更C; 从个人到家庭，再到社会. Each next step is stronger than the previous. Connectors: 而且, 甚至, 更, 乃至.

比喻 — a figurative comparison. In formal, written Chinese, instead of 像 you use 如同, 犹如, and 好比: A + 如同/犹如 + B (+一般). 书籍犹如阶梯 — "books are like a staircase". Often with 一般 or 似的 at the end.
时间犹如流水，一去不复返。
Shíjiān yóurú liúshuǐ, yí qù bú fù fǎn.
Time is like flowing water: once it's gone, it never comes back.

感谢贵公司对我们的支持。
Gǎnxiè guì gōngsī duì wǒmen de zhīchí.

恳请您在百忙之中给予指导。

A letter ends with the formula 此致 (indented) and 敬礼！ (on a new line at the left margin), then the signature and date on the right. A business version is 顺祝商祺 ("wishing you success in business"). Before this, you can add 特此函告 / 期待您的回复.

Yóuyú jiāotōng biànlì, zhèlǐ yóukè zhòngduō; rán'ér, huánjìng bǎohù de yālì yě suí zhī zēngdà.
Thanks to convenient transportation, there are many tourists here; however, the burden on nature is growing too.

岂 (qǐ) is a formal particle of a rhetorical question: 岂 + 能/会/是… ？ = "how could…". The affirmative form means a negation, while 岂不(是) means an affirmation ("isn't it…"). Style: written, journalism and essays.
这样做岂不是浪费时间？
Zhèyàng zuò qǐ bú shì làngfèi shíjiān?
Isn't doing it this way a waste of time?
如此重要的事，岂能儿戏？
Rúcǐ zhòngyào de shì, qǐ néng érxì?
How can you take such an important matter so lightly?
这么好的机会，我们＿＿能轻易放弃？

这么好的机会，我们岂能轻易放弃？
How can you let such a wonderful opportunity slip away so easily?
A 这 B 样做， C 不是 D 自找麻烦？

这样做，岂不是自找麻烦？
Isn't doing it this way just asking for trouble?
A 他 B 这么 C 聪明的人， D 会上这种当？

他这么聪明的人，岂会上这种当？
Would a smart person like him fall for this trick?
我们 A 能 B 眼睁睁 C 看着 D 他失败？

我们岂能眼睁睁看着他失败？
How can we calmly watch him fail?
How can you let such a wonderful opportunity slip away so easily?
这么好的机会，我们岂能轻易放弃？
Won't saying it that way make him even sadder?
你这样说，岂不是让他更难过？
If people don't follow even the most basic rules, won't there be total chaos?

He worked at the company for twenty years — would he betray it for a little money?
他为公司工作了二十年，岂会为了一点小钱出卖公司？
Isn't doing it this way just asking for trouble?
这样做，岂不是自找麻烦？

How can we calmly watch him fail?

何尝 (hécháng) — "how could, not at all". 何尝 + 不/没 + verb = "don't I…?" (in fact, yes); 何尝 + verb = "not at all, never". Style: formal, emotional argument.
Wǒ hécháng bù xiǎng zǎodiǎn huí jiā?
Don't I want to go home early?
Tā hécháng shuōguo zhèyàng de huà?
When has he ever said anything like that?
你以为我不难过吗？我＿＿不想留下来？

你以为我不难过吗？我何尝不想留下来？
Do you think I'm not sad? Don't I want to stay?
A 我 B 不 C 希望 D 大家都满意？

我何尝不希望大家都满意？
Don't I want everyone to be satisfied?
他嘴上 A 说不在乎， B 心里又 C 不 D 在乎呢？

他嘴上说不在乎，心里又何尝不在乎呢？
In words he says he doesn't care, but doesn't he worry inside?
我 A 不想 B 出去 C 走走，可是工作 D 太多了。

我何尝不想出去走走，可是工作太多了。
Don't I want to go out for a walk? It's just that there's too much work.
Do you think I'm not sad? Don't I want to stay?
你以为我不难过吗？我何尝不想留下来？
Honestly, you can't say he didn't try — he was just unlucky.
说实话，他何尝没有努力过，只是运气不好罢了。
He keeps saying he cares about the children, but has he ever really spent time with them?

Don't I know smoking is harmful? I just can't quit.
我何尝不知道吸烟有害健康，可就是戒不掉。
Don't I want everyone to be satisfied?
我何尝不希望大家都满意？
In words he says he doesn't care, but doesn't he worry inside?
他嘴上说不在乎，心里又何尝不在乎呢？
Don't I want to go out for a walk? It's just that there's too much work.
我何尝不想出去走走，可是工作太多了。
难道…不成: "could it be that…?"
Write the hardest characters of the lesson on paper, 3–5 times each.
难道 + statement + 不成？ — a strengthened rhetorical question, "could it be that…?". 不成 at the end adds bewilderment or reproach. Style: colloquial-formal, lively debate.
难道你还要我求你不成？
Nándào nǐ hái yào wǒ qiú nǐ bùchéng?
Do I really have to beg you?
难道这点困难就能把我们吓倒不成？
Nándào zhè diǎn kùnnan jiù néng bǎ wǒmen xiàdǎo bùchéng?
Could such a small difficulty scare us?
＿＿你连这点小事都要我替你做不成？

难道你连这点小事都要我替你做不成？
Do I really have to do even this little thing for you?
难道 A 你 B 想 C 一个人扛下所有责任 D ？

难道你想一个人扛下所有责任不成？
Do you really intend to take all the responsibility on yourself alone?
我们这么多年的朋友， A 你还 B 会 C 为了这点钱 D 出卖我不成？

我们这么多年的朋友，难道你还会为了这点钱出卖我不成？
We've been friends for so many years — would you really betray me over this money?
这么重要的 A 会议，你 B 想一句话 C 不说就 D 走不成？

这么重要的会议，你难道想一句话不说就走不成？
At such an important meeting, do you really intend to leave without a word?
Do I really have to do even this little thing for you?
难道你连这点小事都要我替你做不成？
Do we really have to forget everything that happened because of one apology from him?

何苦: "is it worth the pain?"
Write the hardest characters of the lesson on paper, 3–5 times each.
何苦 (hékǔ) + verb (+ 呢)? = "why put yourself through it, is it worth it?". A reproach for pointless effort or suffering; fixed phrase: 这是何苦呢. Style: neutral, emotionally colored.
为这点小事生气，何苦呢？
Wèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì shēngqì, hékǔ ne?
Getting angry over such a small thing — is it worth it?
你何苦为了别人的错误惩罚自己？
Nǐ hékǔ wèile biérén de cuòwù chéngfá zìjǐ?
Why punish yourself for other people's mistakes?
为了一个绰号跟同学打架，你这是＿＿呢？

为了一个绰号跟同学打架，你这是何苦呢？
Fighting with a classmate over a nickname — why would you do that?
A 孩子 B 已经尽力了，你 C 这样 D 逼他呢？

孩子已经尽力了，你何苦这样逼他呢？
The child was already trying as hard as he could — why pressure him like that?
A 都是一家人， B 为了一套 C 房子闹到 D 法院去？

都是一家人，何苦为了一套房子闹到法院去？
We're all one family — is it worth taking the matter to court over an apartment?
A 已经 B 过去的 C 事，你 D 总拿出来折磨自己呢？

已经过去的事，你何苦总拿出来折磨自己呢？
What's past is past — why keep tormenting yourself with it?
Fighting with a classmate over a nickname — why would you do that?
为了一个绰号跟同学打架，你这是何苦呢？

The child was already trying as hard as he could — why pressure him like that?

何必 (hébì) + verb (+ 呢)? = "why, no need to". It denies that the action is necessary; softer than 何苦, more rhetorical than 不必. Style: neutral.
大家都是朋友，何必这么客气？
Dàjiā dōu shì péngyou, hébì zhème kèqi?
We're all friends — why be so formal?
既然已经决定了，又何必再讨论？
Jìrán yǐjīng juédìng le, yòu hébì zài tǎolùn?
Since it's already been decided, why discuss it again?
会议稍后会转播，你＿＿亲自跑一趟呢？

会议稍后会转播，你何必亲自跑一趟呢？

不是…吗？ — a rhetorical question that reminds you of an obvious fact: subject + 不是 + predicate + 吗？ Often 不就是…吗 for emphasis. Style: speech and journalism.
你不是说今天要交报告吗？
Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yào jiāo bàogào ma?
Didn't you say you're handing in the report today?
这不是明摆着的事实吗？
Zhè bú shì míngbǎizhe de shìshí ma?
这＿＿你上个月刚买的手机吗？怎么就坏了？

Isn't this the same phone you bought last month? How is it broken already?

这家 A 店上周 B 还在 C 打折 D 吗？

哪里 / 哪儿 in a rhetorical question
Write the hardest characters of the lesson on paper, 3–5 times each.
哪里 (哪儿) + verb/adjective？ = "how could, not at all". It denies what was said; 哪儿…得了 — "how could one manage". Style: colloquial; in writing, 哪里 is preferred.
我哪里知道他会突然辞职？
Wǒ nǎlǐ zhīdào tā huì tūrán cízhí?
How was I supposed to know he would suddenly resign?
这么多作业，一个晚上哪儿做得完？
Zhème duō zuòyè, yí gè wǎnshang nǎr zuò de wán?
So much homework — how could I finish it in one evening?
工资这么低，＿＿买得起市中心的房子？

工资这么低，哪儿买得起市中心的房子？
With such a small salary, how could I buy an apartment in the city center?
他 A 刚学了半年中文， B 看 C 得懂这么难的 D 文章？

A 我 B 只是随便说说， C 想到他 D 会当真？

谁 + 不/没 + verb？ = "who doesn't…?" (that is, everyone does); 谁 + verb？ = "who would…?" (that is, no one). 谁说…？ — a sharp objection. Style: speech, journalism.
谁不希望自己的家乡越来越好？
Shéi bù xīwàng zìjǐ de jiāxiāng yuèláiyuè hǎo?
Who doesn't hope their hometown gets better and better?
谁说女孩子学不好理科？
Shéi shuō nǚháizi xué bu hǎo lǐkē?
Who says girls can't learn science?
＿＿不想多陪陪父母？可工作实在太忙了。

谁不想多陪陪父母？可工作实在太忙了。
Who doesn't want to spend more time with their parents? But there really is too much work.

怎能 (written) / 怎么能 (spoken) + verb？ = "how could you...", i.e. "you shouldn't". 怎能不… = "how could you not...", i.e. "you definitely should". Style: 怎能 is written; used in formal speeches and essays.
面对这样的不公，我们怎能沉默？
Miànduì zhèyàng de bùgōng, wǒmen zěn néng chénmò?
How can we stay silent in the face of such injustice?
看到家乡的巨变，怎能不让人感慨？
Kàndào jiāxiāng de jùbiàn, zěn néng bú ràng rén gǎnkǎi?
How can you not be moved when you see the huge changes in your hometown?
大家都这么信任你，你＿＿说话不算数？

大家都这么信任你，你怎能说话不算数？

What is a 歇后语: 竹篮打水
Write the hardest characters of the lesson on paper, 3–5 times each.

A 歇后语 is a two-part, playful phrase: the first part is an image that works like a riddle, and the second (after the dash) is the answer and the meaning. In speech, the second part is often left out, but native speakers still understand it. "竹篮打水——一场空": drawing water with a bamboo basket — all for nothing.
他忙了一年，结果竹篮打水——一场空。
Tā máng le yì nián, jiéguǒ zhúlán dǎ shuǐ — yì chǎng kōng.
He worked hard for a whole year, and in the end it was all for nothing.
没有计划的努力，往往是竹篮打水。
Méiyǒu jìhuà de nǔlì, wǎngwǎng shì zhúlán dǎ shuǐ.
Effort without a plan often turns out to be in vain (the second part is omitted).

如果不改掉拖延的毛病，你的计划只会是竹篮打水——一场空。
If you don't break the habit of procrastinating, your plans will just be wasted effort.

Wordplay: 小葱拌豆腐——一清二白

Many 歇后语 are built on homophones. Green onion with tofu is "一青二白" (one part green, one part white), but it sounds like "一清二白", which means crystal clear, without a single stain. It's used to talk about honesty, innocence, or a matter being completely clear.
我的账目是小葱拌豆腐——一清二白，不怕查。
Wǒ de zhàngmù shì xiǎocōng bàn dòufu — yìqīng-èrbái, bú pà chá.
My accounts are squeaky clean. Check them as much as you like.
这件事的来龙去脉已经一清二白了。
Zhè jiàn shì de láilóng-qùmài yǐjīng yìqīng-èrbái le.
The whole story behind this matter is now perfectly clear.
小葱是绿色的，豆腐是白色的，所以字面上是“一＿＿二白”。

小葱是绿色的，豆腐是白色的，所以字面上是“一青二白”。
Scallions are green and tofu is white, so literally it's "one green, two white."

Don't do to others what you wouldn't want done to yourself: if you don't like being disturbed, don't disturb others.
“己所不欲，勿施于人”是处理人际关系的基本原则。
“Jǐ suǒ bú yù, wù shī yú rén” shì chǔlǐ rénjì guānxi de jīběn yuánzé.

成语 carry a judgment: 褒义 (praise) or 贬义 (disapproval). Pairs close in meaning: 足智多谋 (resourceful, +) vs. 老谋深算 (cunning and calculating, -); 诡计多端 (full of tricks, -). Getting the connotation wrong is a classic exam trap.

众所周知 / 显而易见 / 不言而喻

众所周知 means "as everyone knows," stressing that a fact is common knowledge. 显而易见 means "obvious," where the result is visible right away. 不言而喻 means "goes without saying," where the conclusion is clear without words, often about importance (重要性不言而喻). All three are literary and suitable for essays.

对方辩友所言看似有理，实则本末倒置。写作的过程本身就是思维训练的过程，如果学生从一开始就依赖机器代劳，独立思考和逻辑论证的能力必然日渐荒废。工具可以用，但绝不能在基础训练阶段喧宾夺主。
问：男方的主要观点是什么？
人工智能写作工具应被全面禁止
人工智能写作工具在基础阶段不应取代思维训练
人工智能的写作质量远不如人类
高校应加快普及人工智能课程

A debate about AI writing tools at universities: the woman is for introducing them (they save time for creativity); the man says writing trains thinking, and at the basic stage AI shouldn't replace independent work. Question: What is the man's main point?
我方坚持认为，城市发展应优先保护历史街区。老建筑承载着一座城市的集体记忆，一旦拆除便不可复得，这是任何经济利益都无法弥补的损失。
对方辩友，保护固然重要，但我们不能对居住在老街区里的居民视而不见。许多老房子年久失修，没有独立卫生间，消防隐患重重。一味强调原貌保护，难道要让居民世世代代忍受这样的生活条件吗？我方主张的是在改善民生的前提下有选择地保护。
问：女方反驳对方时主要依据的是什么？
拆除老建筑能带来巨大的经济利益
历史街区缺乏文化价值
老街区居民的居住条件亟待改善
政府缺乏保护老建筑的资金

Debate: the man says the priority is protecting historic neighborhoods (the city's memory); the woman says residents can't be ignored: the houses are dilapidated, have no bathrooms and are fire hazards; protect selectively while improving people's lives. Question: What does her objection rest on?
我方认为，远程办公利大于弊。员工省去了通勤时间，工作效率不降反升；企业也节省了大笔办公场地的租金，可谓一举两得。
对方辩友只看到了账面上的收益。然而，团队协作中的灵感碰撞、新人在耳濡目染中的成长，恰恰发生在面对面的交流之中。长期远程办公，员工之间日渐疏离，企业文化名存实亡，这些隐性成本迟早会反映在创新能力上。
问：男方认为远程办公的主要问题是什么？
增加了企业的租金支出
延长了员工的通勤时间
导致员工工作时间过长
削弱团队交流与企业文化，影响创新

A debate about remote work: the woman says it saves time and rent; the man says face-to-face communication, training of newcomers and corporate culture are lost, which in the end hurts innovation. Question: What is the main problem in the man's view?
林教授，您从事敦煌壁画修复工作已有三十余年，是什么让您坚持至今？
说实话，最初只是服从分配，谈不上什么热爱。可是当你日复一日面对那些历经千年风沙的壁画，看着一块块剥落的颜料在自己手中重新稳固下来，那种与古人对话的感觉，是任何东西都替代不了的。
现在有了数字化技术，传统修复还有必要吗？
数字化能留住影像，却留不住壁画本身。二者相辅相成，而非取而代之。
问：林教授对数字化技术的看法是什么？
数字化技术与传统修复应互为补充
数字化技术可以完全取代传统修复
数字化技术对壁画保护毫无意义
传统修复技术已经过时

An interview with a restorer of Dunhuang murals (30+ years): he started by assignment, but came to love the "dialogue with the ancients." Digital technology preserves the image but not the mural itself — they complement, not replace, each other. Question: What is his view of digitization?
周女士，您的公司创立不到五年，就成为新能源汽车电池回收领域的领头羊，秘诀是什么？
谈不上秘诀。创业之初，很多人觉得电池回收是个脏活累活，不屑一顾。可我看到的是，随着第一批新能源汽车进入报废期，这将是一片蓝海。我们提前三年布局回收网络，等市场真正爆发的时候，别人才开始起步。
那您认为未来最大的挑战在哪里？
行业标准不统一。小作坊拆解成本低，却污染严重，扰乱了市场秩序。
问：周女士的公司成功的主要原因是什么？
获得了大量的政府补贴
提前预判市场并抢先布局
拥有独家的电池生产技术
与大型车企建立了合资关系

An interview with the founder of an electric-vehicle battery recycling company: her success is that she foresaw the market's growth three years ahead and built a collection network. The industry's main problems are the lack of unified standards and dirty backyard workshops. Question: What is the reason for her success?
黄导演，您的新片以一个普通快递员为主角，没有大明星，也没有特效，上映后却口碑爆棚，您事先预料到了吗？
完全没有。投资方一度认为题材太平淡，劝我加一些戏剧冲突。可我始终觉得，真实本身就有千钧之力。观众在银幕上看到了自己，看到了身边人，这种共鸣是任何噱头都给不了的。
有评论说这部电影过于沉重，您怎么回应？
生活本来就有沉重的一面，我只是没有刻意回避而已。
问：导演认为影片受欢迎的原因是什么？
投资方加入了强烈的戏剧冲突
影片邀请了著名演员参演
影片运用了先进的特效技术
影片真实地反映了普通人的生活

An interview with the director of a film about a delivery courier — no stars or special effects, but great reviews. Investors asked him to add drama, and he refused: the strength is in the truth, and viewers recognize themselves. Question: Why is the film successful?
吴医生，最近“轻断食”在年轻人中非常流行，您怎么看？
轻断食对部分超重人群确实有一定益处，但它绝不是放之四海而皆准的减肥良方。我在门诊中遇到不少年轻女性，盲目跟风，结果出现低血糖、月经紊乱，甚至诱发了进食障碍。
任何饮食干预都应在专业人士的评估和指导下进行。与其追逐网红方法，不如踏踏实实地调整作息、均衡饮食、适量运动。
问：吴医生对“轻断食”的态度是什么？
非常推崇，建议所有人尝试
完全否定，认为毫无科学依据
认为有一定作用，但反对盲目跟风

An interview with a doctor about the trendy intermittent fasting: it may help some overweight people, but it isn't universal; following it blindly leads to hypoglycemia, menstrual irregularities and eating disorders. Her advice: only under a specialist's supervision. Question: What is her attitude?
今天我们来谈谈“确认偏误”。所谓确认偏误，是指人们倾向于搜集、解读和记忆那些能够印证自己既有观点的信息，而对相反的证据视而不见。在信息爆炸的时代，这一心理机制被算法推荐不断放大：你越是关注某类观点，平台就越是向你推送同类内容，久而久之，便形成了所谓的“信息茧房”。要想破茧而出，最有效的办法就是主动接触与自己立场相左的观点，并对其保持开放而审慎的态度。
问：讲座认为怎样才能摆脱“信息茧房”？
完全停止使用社交平台
只阅读权威媒体的报道
主动接触不同观点并审慎对待
请算法推荐更多同类内容

A lecture on "confirmation bias": people look for information that confirms their opinion; algorithms amplify the effect and create an "information cocoon." The way out is to consciously get to know opposing views, openly and critically. Question: How do you get out of the cocoon?
各位同学，提起宋代，很多人首先想到的是“积贫积弱”。然而，近年来经济史学界的研究表明，宋代的商品经济之发达，在中国古代可谓首屈一指。城市中打破了坊市界限，夜市通宵达旦；世界上最早的纸币“交子”也诞生于此时。军事上的屡屡失利，并不能掩盖其在经济、科技与文化上的辉煌成就。因此，我们评价一个朝代，切忌以偏概全。
问：讲座者想要表达的主要观点是什么？
宋代军事力量是中国古代最强的
宋代经济落后导致了军事失败
纸币的出现加速了宋代的灭亡
不应只凭军事失利就全面否定宋代

A lecture: the Song dynasty is often considered "poor and weak," but its commodity economy was the most developed in ancient China — night markets, the first paper money, "jiaozi." Military defeats don't cancel out its achievements; we shouldn't judge one-sidedly. Question: What is the main idea?
我们常说“熟能生巧”，但心理学研究发现，单纯的重复练习未必能带来技能的持续提升。真正起作用的是所谓的“刻意练习”：它要求练习者明确具体目标，专注于自己尚未掌握的薄弱环节，并及时获得反馈、不断修正。许多人练了十年琴依然水平平平，原因就在于他们只是在舒适区里机械重复。换言之，决定进步的，不是练习时间的长短，而是练习的质量。
问：根据讲座，决定技能进步的关键是什么？

A lecture on "deliberate practice": simple repetition doesn't guarantee growth; you need a specific goal, work on weak spots and feedback. Many people play for 10 years and stay at an average level because they repeat within their comfort zone. Question: What determines progress? — The quality of practice.
城市热岛效应，是指城市中心区域的气温明显高于周边郊区的现象。造成这一现象的原因是多方面的：首先，沥青和混凝土大量吸收并储存太阳辐射；其次，高楼林立阻碍了空气流通，热量难以散发；再次，空调、汽车等人为热源持续排放。值得一提的是，增加城市绿地和水体面积，是目前公认的成本最低、成效最显著的缓解手段，一片面积适中的城市公园，可使周边气温下降两到三摄氏度。
问：讲座中提到的最经济有效的缓解措施是什么？

A lecture on the urban "heat island": the causes are that asphalt and concrete accumulate heat, high-rises block air circulation, and air conditioners and cars give off heat. The cheapest and most effective remedy is more greenery and bodies of water (a park lowers the temperature by 2–3°C). Question: What is the most effective remedy?
每年深秋，上千只丹顶鹤从遥远的北方飞抵黄海之滨的滩涂湿地越冬。然而，就在二十多年前，这片湿地曾因围海造田而大面积萎缩，前来越冬的鹤群一度锐减至不足百只。此后，当地退田还湿，严格限制人类活动，湿地生态逐渐恢复。如今，这里不仅重现了鹤舞翩跹的壮观景象，还吸引了近四百种鸟类在此栖息，成为名副其实的“鸟类天堂”。
问：二十多年前鹤群数量锐减的原因是什么？
围海造田导致湿地萎缩
气候变暖使候鸟改变路线
非法捕猎现象十分严重
湿地水源受到工业污染

A documentary: about a thousand red-crowned cranes winter on the Yellow Sea coast. 20 years ago, wetlands shrank because of drainage for fields, and there were fewer than 100 cranes. After the wetlands were restored, flocks returned — along with about 400 species of birds. Question: What was the reason for the flock's decline?
在云南西双版纳的深山里，至今仍保留着上千年的古茶树。当地的布朗族人世代以茶为生，他们始终遵循着祖祖辈辈传下来的古老规矩：采茶时只采一芽两叶，绝不竭泽而渔。老人们常说，茶树是祖先留给子孙的财富，只能取之有度，不能据为己有。正是这份朴素的敬畏之心，让古茶园历经千年而生机盎然，也让普洱茶的醇厚滋味得以代代相传。
问：这段纪录片主要赞扬的是什么？
普洱茶高昂的市场价格
布朗族人对自然取之有度的敬畏之心
布朗族人先进的制茶工艺
西双版纳独特的旅游资源

A documentary about thousand-year-old tea trees in Xishuangbanna: the Bulang people pick only "one bud and two leaves," without exhausting the trees; "take in moderation, don't appropriate." Thanks to this reverence, the tea gardens have lived for a thousand years. Question: What is praised?
这是一座始建于明代的石拱桥，横跨江南水乡的一条小河，五百余年来，风雨不侵，屹立不倒。令人叹服的是，整座桥没有使用一颗铁钉，也没有任何黏合剂，全凭石块之间精确的榫卯咬合与自身重力相互支撑。当地工匠说，古人建桥讲究“宁慢勿快”，一块石料往往要反复打磨数月才能嵌入桥身。这种精益求精的匠心，正是古桥历久弥坚的根本所在。
问：根据纪录片，这座古桥能够保存至今的根本原因是什么？
桥身使用了大量铁钉加固
当地政府多次进行了翻修
江南地区气候温和少雨
古代工匠精益求精的匠心

A documentary about a Ming-dynasty stone arch bridge (500+ years): not a single nail or any glue — only precise mortise-and-tenon joints and the weight of the stones; each block was polished for months. The fundamental reason for its durability is craftsmanship and the pursuit of perfection. Question: Why has the bridge survived?
凌晨四点，当城市还在沉睡，这家老字号早点铺的灯已经亮起。六十八岁的老李揉着面团，动作娴熟而专注。四十年来，他坚持用传统的老面发酵，一笼包子要花上六七个小时。儿子曾劝他改用速发酵母，省时省力，老李却摇摇头：“味道差一点，客人嘴上不说，心里是知道的。”如今，慕名而来的年轻食客越来越多，小店门前常常排起长队。
问：老李为什么拒绝使用速发酵母？
政府禁止使用速发酵母

A documentary about 68-year-old Mr. Li, who has been making baozi for 40 years using a traditional starter (6–7 hours). His son suggested quick yeast, but Li refused: "The taste will get worse — customers won't say anything, but they'll notice." Now there are lines at his shop. Question: Why did he refuse the yeast?
各位同仁，回顾过去一年，我们的线上业务虽然实现了百分之三十的增长，但客户投诉率同比上升了近一倍，主要集中在物流延误和售后响应迟缓两个方面。我想强调的是，规模扩张绝不能以牺牲服务质量为代价。下一阶段，公司将暂缓新市场的开拓，集中资源升级仓储系统，并将售后响应时间压缩至二十四小时以内。请各部门据此调整工作计划，下月初提交具体方案。
问：发言人对下一阶段工作的部署是什么？
加快开拓新市场，扩大业务规模
削减线上业务，回归线下经营
增加广告投入，提高品牌知名度
优先提升服务质量，暂缓扩张

A speech at a meeting: online sales grew by 30%, but complaints doubled (logistics, slow service). Growth must not come at the expense of quality: expansion into new markets is being suspended, and resources will go to warehouses and 24-hour support. Question: What is the plan for the next stage?
尊敬的主席、各位代表：气候变化是全人类面临的共同挑战，任何国家都无法独善其身。发展中国家在历史上排放较少，却首当其冲地承受着海平面上升、极端天气频发的严重后果。因此，我们呼吁发达国家切实履行资金和技术援助的承诺，而不是停留在口头上。同时，我国也将继续坚定推进能源结构转型，力争在既定时间内实现碳达峰，为全球气候治理贡献应有的力量。
问：发言人向发达国家提出了什么要求？
落实资金和技术援助的承诺
立即停止使用一切化石能源
承担发展中国家的全部减排任务
取消对发展中国家的贸易限制

A speech at a climate conference: developing countries emitted less but suffer more; a call on developed countries to actually fulfill their promises of financial and technological help, not just in words. The country will continue its energy transition. Question: What is demanded of developed countries?
各位专家，关于职业教育改革，我想谈一点个人看法。长期以来，社会上存在着“重学历、轻技能”的偏见，职业院校往往被视为考不上大学的无奈之选。这种观念不改变，再多的政策扶持也只能是杯水车薪。我认为，破局的关键在于打通职业教育与普通教育之间的升学通道，同时提高技术工人的薪酬待遇和社会地位，让“一技之长”真正成为安身立命的本钱。
问：发言人认为职业教育发展的主要障碍是什么？
政府扶持资金严重不足
社会“重学历、轻技能”的观念
职业院校的师资力量薄弱
企业不愿招收技术工人

A speech on vocational education reform: the main problem is the prejudice of "valuing diplomas over skills"; vocational colleges are seen as a choice for losers. The solution is to open a path from vocational education to universities and to raise workers' pay and status. Question: What is the main obstacle?
据国家统计局最新发布的数据，今年前三季度，全国居民人均可支配收入同比实际增长百分之五点一，其中农村居民收入增速连续多个季度高于城镇居民，城乡收入差距进一步缩小。分析人士指出，这一变化主要得益于乡村特色产业的蓬勃发展以及农村电商的迅速普及。不过，专家同时提醒，部分地区产业同质化现象较为突出，一旦市场需求饱和，增收势头恐难以为继，因此亟须因地制宜、错位发展。
问：专家对农村收入增长持什么看法？
增长完全依靠政府补贴，不具备可持续性
肯定成绩，但担心产业同质化影响后劲
认为城乡收入差距已经基本消除
主张农村应放弃电商，回归传统农业

News: rural residents' incomes are growing faster than urban ones thanks to local industries and e-commerce, but experts warn about uniform, repetitive production. Question: How do the experts assess the growth? — They acknowledge the success but fear that sameness among industries will undermine the sustainability of growth.

谈不上秘诀。创业之初，很多人觉得电池回收是个脏活累活，不屑一顾。可我看到的是，随着第一批新能源汽车进入报废期，这将是一片蓝海。我们提前三年布局回收网络，等市场真正爆发的时候，别人才开始起步。

行业标准不统一。小作坊拆解成本低，却污染严重，扰乱了市场秩序。

城市热岛效应，是指城市中心区域的气温明显高于周边郊区的现象。造成这一现象的原因是多方面的：首先，沥青和混凝土大量吸收并储存太阳辐射；其次，高楼林立阻碍了空气流通，热量难以散发；再次，空调、汽车等人为热源持续排放。值得一提的是，增加城市绿地和水体面积，是目前公认的成本最低、成效最显著的缓解手段，一片面积适中的城市公园，可使周边气温下降两到三摄氏度。
